known_issues: Human-authorized test patch. Gameplay, actual native/Harmony startup, multiplayer and FPS are UNRUN; this is not a STABLE or full LIVE-verified release.

Automatic sap collection uses base output when builder Farming evidence is offline or stale.
New Ward roles, patrol/leisure behavior, FIFO fuel policy and related successor behavior are excluded for the next patch.
